item: 6061-T6 flat bar 1 x 3-1/2 in, saw-cut to 5 in
pricing_basis: $21.40 per foot of bar (10.5 ft for 25 pcs incl. kerf/roundup) + $3.00 per cut; about $11.99/piece before tax and delivery
delivery: Flat $35 on their truck to Oakland (East Bay), ships next business day; or same-day will-call pickup in San Leandro if ordered before 2 PM
substitutions: Offered 1 in thick instead of the requested 1-1/8 in. This is under the 1.11 in minimum blank thickness, so it does not work for the part.
open_questions: The quoted 1 x 3-1/2 bar is too thin (1.00 in vs the 1.11 in minimum). The buyer rejected it, so this quote can't be used as written.

The supplier contradicted itself. It first listed 1-1/4 x 3-1/2 at $26.80/ft, 1-1/4 x 4 at $30.50/ft and 1-1/2 x 3-1/2 at $32.xx/ft (cut off). Then it said it stocks nothing 1.11 in thick or thicker in this line. Need to confirm whether 1-1/4 or 1-1/2 thick 6061-T6 bar is actually available, and get a firm price.
The transcript ends mid-sentence before the supplier gives any alternative for the 1.11 x 3.31 x 4.89 blank.
Arithmetic checks out: 10.5 ft x $21.40 = $224.70; 25 cuts x $3 = $75; subtotal $299.70; plus $35 delivery = $334.70.
